free_tier.stated: Free, $0 a month: 1 concurrent phone, 60 phone credits a month (60 Android or 20 iPhone minutes), 500 AI credits ($5), 1 GB residential traffic, 1 seat; no overage charges and prepaid top-ups available.
free_tier.notes: A stopped Android phone keeps its apps and data and uses no phone credits; phone credits are pooled per month across phones.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is phone minutes, not an object; Free includes 1 GB of storage per the plan comparison table

retention.stated: A stopped Android phone keeps its apps and data; terminating it erases them. No fixed retention window is published for cloud phones.

egress.terms: 1 GB of residential traffic is included on Free with no overage available on that plan; paid plans include 5 to 15 GB and then pay $10 per GB. A dedicated residential IP with unlimited bandwidth is a separate $20 per 4 weeks add-on.
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB of residential traffic a month on Free
egress.price_per_tb: USD 10,000 per TB on paid plans

interface_detail: Cloud devices and agent tasks are driven through a hosted dashboard, a REST API with API keys, an MCP server and TypeScript and Python SDKs.
tooling: pip or npm install the Mobilerun SDK, or call the REST API at api.mobilerun.ai; an MCP server connects Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents.
chaining: A cloud Android phone paid by the minute runs an agent that can open apps and read SMS, with residential traffic from this plan or a dedicated residential IP for a stable exit address.

limits.value: 60 phone credits a month on Free, equal to 60 Android or 20 iPhone minutes, pooled across phones
1 concurrent phone and 1 GB of residential traffic a month on Free
Free stops at its limit with no paid overage; paid plans continue up to a monthly overage limit

limits_note: An iPhone minute uses 3 phone credits against 1 for Android, and Free includes enough credits for 20 iPhone minutes a month.
binding_note: On Free the 60 phone credits and 1 GB of residential traffic run out first, and with no paid overage the phone is then stopped while keeping its data, so the monthly allowance binds before the single-phone concurrency cap.

identity_cost.detail: The terms state that the service is directed exclusively at business customers and that DroidRun may require proof of business status before the contract; registration requires a DroidRun account with complete information about the person or entity, and paid plans are confirmed by email. The pricing page notes that one slot to connect your own phone needs no credit card on eligible accounts. No phone number or ID document is stated on the pages read.

reliability_note: The terms provide the service as is with no warranty of availability or correctness; stopping and resuming a Cloud iOS phone is not available yet, and a pay-as-you-go phone is stopped when its minutes run out, keeping its data.
confidence_note: The free allowance, credit rates, traffic allowance and registration terms are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page, credits documentation and terms read on 2026-11-24.
